evidence: pre-commit lane 1 resolves its implementation beside the hook and fails closed when missing
lane 1 compares candidate GIT_INDEX_FILE against the real index and refuses a real staged deletion that disappears from the candidate index while the worktree file still exists
commit-msg wrapper resolves beside the hook and fails closed when its implementation is missing
verification-level checker has explicit known-bad and known-good selftests

autofix_policy.decision: Correct for this shared worktree. The fixer can mutate files without restaging them; running it inside commit would commit old bytes and leave rewritten files dirty. --check reports the exact explicit remediation instead.
autofix_policy.residual: If LOOP_KIT/autofix-precommit.sh is absent, pre-commit reports AUTOFIX_LANE_SKIPPED and exits 0; this is a fail-open optional dependency and should remain an explicit separate policy decision, not be called full coverage.

evidence: real_index is resolved with env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE
candidate_index is taken from GIT_INDEX_FILE when present
git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=D is run under both index values
the satisfying path checks a deletion present in the real index but absent from the candidate and verifies the worktree still has the path
staged_deletion_divergence.residual: The lane is causal for the intended path-limited commit failure. It does not model every exotic index corruption case; those are outside this acceptance contract.

findings.finding: If foundation/gates.d contains no executable [0-9]*-*.sh stages, the shell glob remains literal, [ -x ] skips it, rc stays 0, and the aggregate prints ALL GREEN without running a stage.
findings.reason: This is a real aggregator hardening change requiring its own fixture and gate contract; changing it inline would mix a distinct source mutation into a lineage review. It is recorded as a required follow-up rather than silently treated as green.

findings.finding: A missing optional LOOP_KIT autofix implementation is explicitly skipped with exit 0.
findings.reason: The current design treats the foundry formatter as optional and preserves portability; changing skip to fail closed would alter the install contract and needs a separate decision.

verification.selftest: Kimi K3 caller selftest passed before the call was cancelled; this receipt is the Codex-family independent review, not a Kimi result.

no_claim: No claim that the two recorded divergences are fixed.
No claim that the gates are complete outside the inspected files.
No claim that this review replaces the pane-3 red-team history scrub.
